Question: Select the best translation into predicate logic. All jellybeans are sweeter than all fruit. (Fx: x is a fruit; Jx: x is a jellybean; Sxy: x is sweeter than y)

Options: 
A. (∀x)[Fx ⊃ (∀y)(Jy ⊃ Sxy)]
B. (∀x)(∀y)[(Fx • Jy) • Sxy]
C. (∀x)(∀y)[Sxy ⊃ (Fy • Jx)]
D. (∀x)[Jx ⊃ (∀y)(Fy ⊃ Sxy)]

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
